description: Change the dates and/or the place of one trip in a Nomads.com member's own history, e.g. a stay that got longer or a wrong city. Authenticated as the member (signed in through the connector with OAuth or an Authorization header, or username + personal key from https://nomads.com/settings). Needs the trip_id (from get_trips); pass only what changes, everything else keeps its value. The trip keeps its trip_id, likes and comments. A new place works like add_trip: city_slug, OR latitude+longitude (snaps to a Nomads.com city within 5km, otherwise pass city and country names).

city.description: With latitude/longitude: the place name. Required (with country) for places that have no Nomads.com city within 5km

city_slug.description: New place, from search_cities or get_city. Omit to keep the place

country.description: With city: the place's country name

date_end.description: New end date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to keep

date_start.description: New start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to keep

key.description: From https://nomads.com/settings. Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

latitude.description: New place by coordinates, instead of city_slug

username.description: Omit when signed in through the connector (OAuth or Authorization header)

name: edit_trip
